description: DesignCraft: An open-source page and layout design editor written from scratch in pure Rust

latest_release.name: DesignCraft v0.18.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* M5: keep out-and-back cubic segments in striped strokes by @MMexicann in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/2323
* Pass the Linux signing key to the release workflow by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/2328
* About: credits tables fit without side-scrolling and their columns resize by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/2264
* Pages: parents and alternate layouts; export and print layouts and versions by @Gamedirection in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1342
* Copy: a text frame anchored in a copied frame keeps its text by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/2348
* Esperanto as a text language by @axel584 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1204
* Fix CLI build warnings on Windows by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/2356
* An item a parent overrode and deleted is gone from the pages that use it (#1469) by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1558
* A hyperlink can point at a text anchor (#1446) by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1555
* Frame edges: a frame holding pasted-in content draws its own edge, not its content's (#2345) by @ZIDAN44 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/2368
* IDML import: a page item's or a text run's hyperlink survives (#1446) by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1652
* IDML export: a document's hyperlinks are written out (#1446) by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1659
* Copy the shared house rules into AGENTS.md by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/2390
* Fix iDML import drops a table cell's insets written as `TextTopInset` … by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/2414

## New Contributors
* @Gamedirection made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1342
* @axel584 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1204

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/compare/v0.17.2...v0.18.0

detail.readme_excerpt:
DesignCraft

Page layout and publishing; an open-source, modern desktop publishing and page layout studio, built in pure Rust.

A fast, open-source desktop publishing and page layout workflow. It runs natively on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly.
By the ArtCraft team.


DesignCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps



Quarterly, Spring Issue: threaded three-column body text, a wrapped pull quote and parent-page folios, all set by DesignCraft's own paragraph composer.
